connection.player2AppHelp: Click to open the Player2 application. Make sure it is installed and running.
connection.actionsSchemaTypeHelp: Controls the JSON schema complexity for action responses. 'Auto' detects Gemini models and uses minimized schema. 'Minimized' may be required for models with strict schema limits (like Gemini). If actions don't appear with your model, try switching to 'Minimized'.
connection.promptCachingHelp: When enabled, the conversation prompt prefix (persona + history) is rendered from a frozen game-state snapshot so it stays identical across turns. This lets OpenRouter reuse the cached prefix, lowering cost and latency. A small live "Current State" block carries what changed (gold, traits, relations, current scene). Applies to conversations only — not letters, summaries, or actions. Works with any OpenRouter model (implicit prefix caching + sticky routing).
connection.promptCacheTtlHint: Anthropic models only: 1h survives long pauses between replies (higher write cost); 5m is cheaper per write but expires faster.
connection.promptCachingImplicitHint: This model uses OpenRouter's implicit caching (TTL is provider-managed). The frozen prefix + sticky routing still apply.

prompts.autoSwitchPromptLocale: Automatically switch prompt language to match app language
prompts.autoSwitchPromptLocaleHelp: When enabled, prompt scripts follow the app language, falling back to English when no translation exists.
prompts.label: Label
prompts.leaveEmptyDefault: Leave empty to use default text
prompts.promptBuilderHelp: Reorder, toggle, and edit blocks that compose the prompt.
prompts.cachingBannerTitle: Prompt caching is ON for this provider
prompts.cachingBannerBody: The blocks marked "frozen" are rendered from a game-state snapshot taken when the conversation started, so they stay byte-identical across turns and can be reused from the OpenRouter cache. The live "Current State" block (after history) carries the current scene plus anything that changed since the snapshot (gold, traits, relations). This lowers cost/latency without losing current state.
prompts.frozenBadgeHelp: Part of the cached prefix — rendered from the frozen game-state snapshot.
prompts.liveBadgeHelp: Part of the uncached tail — re-rendered each turn from the live game state.
prompts.currentStateBlockHelp: This block is system-managed. It renders the live current scene (location, participants) plus a compact diff of state changes since the conversation started (gold, traits, relations). It is only emitted when prompt caching is enabled; otherwise it produces nothing. It cannot be edited or reordered — it must stay after History so the cached prefix remains stable.
prompts.systemManagedHelp: System-managed block: automatically enabled/disabled based on the active provider's prompt-caching setting. Cannot be toggled manually.
prompts.pinnedNoReorder: This block is pinned and cannot be reordered.

prompts.promptLocaleSwitchedFallback: No {{language}} version — fell back to English.
prompts.promptLocaleSwitchedHint: Items marked as fallback have no translation for your language, so the English version was used.
prompts.resetMainPrompt: Reset main prompt to default template? This will replace current text.

settings.actionApprovalHelp: Configure when actions require user approval before execution. Destructive actions (like killing characters) always require approval regardless of these settings.
settings.approvalModeNonDestructive: Auto-accept Non-destructive (Only destructive actions require approval)
settings.letterStatusHelp: View the status of all letters in the generation and delivery pipeline.
settings.pauseOnApprovalHelp: When enabled, the conversation will pause when actions need approval, allowing you to review them before continuing.
settings.ck3UserFolderHelp: Click on field below to select/change path to CK3 folder. Usually it is in "Documents" folder. OneDrive location is likely to fail!
settings.allowPrereleaseHelp: When enabled, you will receive beta and pre-release versions. These may be less stable but include the latest features.

summaries.aboutSummaryGenerationHelp: Summaries are automatically generated in two scenarios:
summaries.configureSummaries: Configure how conversation summaries are generated.
summaries.confirmClearSummaries: Are you sure you want to clear all conversation summaries? This action cannot be undone.
summaries.contextSettingsHelp: Configure how summaries are included in prompts.
summaries.conversationSummaryManagementHelp: Manage conversation summaries stored for your characters.
summaries.finalSummariesHelp: Generated when a conversation ends. These comprehensive summaries are saved to character files and used as context in future conversations.
summaries.finalSummaryPromptHelp: This prompt is used at the end of a conversation to create a comprehensive summary that will be saved for future reference.
summaries.legacyDataImportHelp: Import conversation summaries from legacy VOTC installation. Existing summaries will be backed up.
summaries.letterSummaryPromptHelp: This prompt is used to generate summaries for letter exchanges between characters. These summaries are saved to character files and used as context in future conversations.
summaries.maxPastSummariesHelp: The maximum number of past conversation summaries to include in prompts. Higher values provide more context but use more tokens.
summaries.promptsActiveInfo: The prompts below show the current active prompts. Changes are automatically saved after you stop typing.
summaries.providerOverrideHelp: Choose a specific provider for generating conversation summaries. Leave as "Use Active Provider" to use your currently selected provider.
summaries.resetAllPrompts: Reset all summary prompts to defaults? This will replace all current text.
summaries.resetFinalPrompt: Reset final summary prompt to default? This will replace current text.
summaries.resetLetterSummaryPrompt: Reset letter summary prompt to default? This will replace current text.
summaries.resetRollingPrompt: Reset rolling summary prompt to default? This will replace current text.
summaries.rollingSummariesHelp: Created during long conversations when the context limit is approaching. These help compress older messages while preserving important information.
summaries.rollingSummaryPromptHelp: This prompt is used when the conversation gets too long and needs to be compressed. It creates incremental summaries during the conversation.
